title: gnaphalium contortum
intro: Gnaphalium contortum, commonly known as Contorted Cudweed, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, making it a useful treatment for conditions such as asthma and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Gnaphalium contortum are attributed to its ability to inhibit histamine release, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
